es: Escribe o pega con Ctrl+V. Intro conecta.

keys: No response from the other player
en: No response from the other player

keys: A straight discharge from the cheeks. Fast and cheap.
en: A straight discharge from the cheeks. Fast and cheap.
es: Descarga en línea recta desde las mejillas. Rápida y barata.

keys: Dashes in a straight line, hitting whatever is in the way. No invulnerability.
en: Dashes in a straight line, hitting whatever is in the way. No invulnerability.
es: Se lanza en línea recta golpeando lo que encuentra. Sin invulnerabilidad.

keys: Spins and strikes with a steel tail that launches the target. In the air, it dives.
en: Spins and strikes with a steel tail that launches the target. In the air, it dives.
es: Gira y golpea con la cola de acero: lanza por los aires. En el aire, cae en picado.

keys: Like in the anime: gathers electricity on the tip of its tail and flings it with a tail flip. Flies in an arc (good against flyers) and bursts in an area.
en: Like in the anime: gathers electricity on the tip of its tail and flings it with a tail flip. Flies in an arc (good against flyers) and bursts in an area.
es: Como en el anime: junta la electricidad en la punta de la cola y la lanza de un coletazo. Sale en parábola (buena contra los que vuelan) y estalla en área.

keys: Jumps and lands with all its weight. Only heavy hits interrupt it.
en: Jumps and lands with all its weight. Only heavy hits interrupt it.
es: Salta y cae con todo su peso. Solo le cortan los golpes fuertes.

keys: A wide punch that chills: the target is slowed for 2 s.
en: A wide punch that chills: the target is slowed for 2 s.
es: Puñetazo amplio que deja helado: el rival va más lento 2 s.

keys: A stomp that sends a shockwave along the ground. Only hits whoever is touching the ground.
en: A stomp that sends a shockwave along the ground. Only hits whoever is touching the ground.
es: Pisotón que lanza una onda por el suelo. Solo alcanza a quien está pisando el suelo.

keys: Falls asleep and recovers a third of its HP. Twice per battle.
en: Falls asleep and recovers a third of its HP. Twice per battle.
es: Se duerme y recupera un tercio de la vida. Dos veces por combate.

keys: Hold for a cone of fire. It turns slowly while firing.
en: Hold for a cone of fire. It turns slowly while firing.
es: Mantén para un chorro de fuego en cono. Mientras lo lanza, gira despacio.

keys: A horizontal blade of air. Also usable in the air.
en: A horizontal blade of air. Also usable in the air.
es: Una cuchilla de aire que corta en horizontal. También en el aire.

keys: Two quick advancing swipes. Opens combos.
en: Two quick advancing swipes. Opens combos.
es: Dos zarpazos rápidos avanzando. Abre combos.

keys: Wraps itself in flames and charges in a line. Shrugs off light hits and takes recoil when it lands.
en: Wraps itself in flames and charges in a line. Shrugs off light hits and takes recoil when it lands.
es: Se envuelve en llamas y embiste en línea. Aguanta golpes ligeros y se hace daño al acertar.

keys: Wraps itself in water and shoots forward in a line. The fastest thing it has.
en: Wraps itself in water and shoots forward in a line. The fastest thing it has.
es: Se envuelve en agua y sale disparado en línea. Lo más rápido que tiene.

keys: Hold for a high-pressure stream from its cannons. Pushes very hard; it cannot move while firing.
en: Hold for a high-pressure stream from its cannons. Pushes very hard; it cannot move while firing.
es: Mantén para un chorro a presión desde los cañones. Empuja muchísimo; mientras dispara no se mueve.

keys: Hides in its shell and spins around the field, hitting. Steered with the stick; it also removes slowness.
en: Hides in its shell and spins around the field, hitting. Steered with the stick; it also removes slowness.
es: Se mete en el caparazón y gira por el campo golpeando. Se dirige con el stick y quita la lentitud.

keys: A straight beam that chills the target and leaves a strip of ice on the ground: whoever steps on it is slowed.
en: A straight beam that chills the target and leaves a strip of ice on the ground: whoever steps on it is slowed.
es: Rayo recto que hiela al rival y deja una franja de hielo en el suelo: quien la pisa va lento.

keys: Two long vines lash forward and pull the target toward Venusaur.
en: Two long vines lash forward and pull the target toward Venusaur.
es: Dos lianas largas que azotan por delante y tiran del rival hacia Venusaur.

keys: Three leaves in a fan. Up close, all three hit.
en: Three leaves in a fan. Up close, all three hit.
es: Tres hojas en abanico. De cerca entran las tres.

keys: A lobbed bomb that lands where the ground is marked. Leaves a puddle that poisons whoever steps in it.
en: A lobbed bomb that lands where the ground is marked. Leaves a puddle that poisons whoever steps in it.
es: Bomba en parábola que cae donde marca el suelo. Deja un charco que envenena a quien lo pisa.

keys: Gathers sunlight for over a second and fires a huge beam. A crushing hit, very punishable.
en: Gathers sunlight for over a second and fires a huge beam. A crushing hit, very punishable.
es: Recoge la luz durante más de un segundo y suelta un rayo enorme. Golpe durísimo, muy castigable.

keys: Hold to charge, like in Smash: uncharged it is slow and homes in a lot; fully charged it is big, fast, straight and hits hard.
en: Hold to charge, like in Smash: uncharged it is slow and homes in a lot; fully charged it is big, fast, straight and hits hard.
es: Mantén para cargar, como en Smash: sin cargar es lenta y persigue mucho; cargada es grande, rápida, recta y pega fuerte.

keys: A punch that comes down like a meteor: advances and hits hard.
en: A punch that comes down like a meteor: advances and hits hard.
es: Puñetazo que cae como un meteoro: avanza y golpea fuerte.

keys: Crosses the field almost instantly, hitting and passing through the target: it ends up behind it.
en: Crosses the field almost instantly, hitting and passing through the target: it ends up behind it.
es: Cruza el campo casi al instante, golpeando y atravesando al rival: acaba a su espalda.

keys: Reads the attack: if hit during the short window, it takes nothing and the attacker is stunned. If it whiffs, Lucario is exposed.
en: Reads the attack: if hit during the short window, it takes nothing and the attacker is stunned. If it whiffs, Lucario is exposed.
es: Lee el golpe: si le alcanzan en la ventana breve, no le hace nada y el atacante queda aturdido. Si falla, queda expuesto.

keys: A ball of shadow that slightly follows the target.
en: A ball of shadow that slightly follows the target.
es: Bola de sombras que sigue un poco al rival.

keys: Marks the ground under the target and bursts. Double damage if the target is poisoned, burned, chilled or charged.
en: Marks the ground under the target and bursts. Double damage if the target is poisoned, burned, chilled or charged.
es: Marca el suelo bajo el rival y estalla. Hace el doble si el rival está envenenado, quemado, helado o cargado.

keys: Leaves an identical decoy where it stood. Gengar turns translucent and faster for a moment. The decoy breaks on the first hit.
en: Leaves an identical decoy where it stood. Gengar turns translucent and faster for a moment. The decoy breaks on the first hit.
es: Deja un señuelo idéntico donde estaba. Gengar se vuelve translúcido y más rápido un momento. El señuelo se deshace al primer golpe.

keys: Burrows underground and moves (hold). On release, it bursts out launching the target. Underground only Earthquake reaches it, for double damage.
en: Burrows underground and moves (hold). On release, it bursts out launching the target. Underground only Earthquake reaches it, for double damage.
es: Se mete bajo tierra y avanza (mantén). Al soltar, sale lanzando por los aires. Bajo tierra solo le alcanza Terremoto, que le hace el doble.

keys: Cracks run toward the target and, behind them, rock spikes burst out one after another.
en: Cracks run toward the target and, behind them, rock spikes burst out one after another.
es: Grietas en línea hacia el rival y, tras ellas, estacas de roca que salen una tras otra.

keys: Three water shuriken in a row, each one aimed as it is thrown.
en: Three water shuriken in a row, each one aimed as it is thrown.
es: Tres shuriken de agua seguidos, cada uno apuntado al soltarlo.

keys: Vanishes and reappears beside the target, slashing. From far away it only closes in.
en: Vanishes and reappears beside the target, slashing. From far away it only closes in.
es: Desaparece y aparece al costado del rival cortando. Lejos, solo se acerca.

keys: Two copies at its sides that break on the first hit. They confuse, they do not protect.
en: Two copies at its sides that break on the first hit. They confuse, they do not protect.
es: Dos copias a sus lados que se deshacen al primer golpe. Confunden, no protegen.

keys: An almost instant advancing punch. Chains into other moves.
en: An almost instant advancing punch. Chains into other moves.
es: Puñetazo casi instantáneo avanzando. Encadena con otros movimientos.

keys: Two slashes that cross in an X; the second one is heavy.
en: Two slashes that cross in an X; the second one is heavy.
es: Dos tajos que se cruzan en X; el segundo es fuerte.

keys: Dances with the swords (vulnerable): its next two physical hits deal 50% more.
en: Dances with the swords (vulnerable): its next two physical hits deal 50% more.
es: Baila con las espadas (vulnerable): sus dos siguientes golpes físicos hacen un 50 % más.

keys: Rises on its wings and charges a short distance.
en: Rises on its wings and charges a short distance.
es: Se alza con las alas y embiste en línea corta.

keys: It flies straight: sidestep it or dodge through it.
en: It flies straight: sidestep it or dodge through it.
es: Va recta: se esquiva moviéndose de lado o con la esquiva.

keys: If it misses, Pikachu is exposed for a moment. The flash gives it away.
en: If it misses, Pikachu is exposed for a moment. The flash gives it away.
es: Si falla queda expuesto un momento. Se ve el destello antes de salir.

keys: The tail glows before the hit: there is time to step away. Long recovery if it misses.
en: The tail glows before the hit: there is time to step away. Long recovery if it misses.
es: La cola brilla antes del golpe: hay tiempo para apartarse. Recuperación larga si falla.

keys: The tail flip warns you: sidestep or leave the area before it bursts.
en: The tail flip warns you: sidestep or leave the area before it bursts.
es: El giro del coletazo avisa: esquiva de lado o sal del área antes de que estalle.

keys: You can see where it will land. It takes a long time to recover after landing: punish it.
en: You can see where it will land. It takes a long time to recover after landing: punish it.
es: Se ve dónde va a caer. Tras aterrizar tarda mucho en recuperarse: castígalo.

keys: The fist frosts over first: back off or dodge backwards.
en: The fist frosts over first: back off or dodge backwards.
es: El puño se carga de escarcha antes: retrocede o esquiva hacia atrás.

keys: Jump when the wave reaches you. You can see it coming: the body rises first.
en: Jump when the wave reaches you. You can see it coming: the body rises first.
es: Salta cuando la onda llegue a ti. Se ve venir: levanta el cuerpo antes.

keys: While asleep it takes 35% more damage and cannot defend itself: attack now.
en: While asleep it takes 35% more damage and cannot defend itself: attack now.
es: Dormido recibe un 35 % más y no puede defenderse: es el momento de atacar.

keys: It is long and turns slowly: you cannot back out of it, so circle around it. It stays still for a moment at the end.
en: It is long and turns slowly: you cannot back out of it, so circle around it. It stays still for a moment at the end.
es: Es largo y gira lento: hacia atrás no se sale, rodéalo por un lado. Al acabar se queda quieto un momento.

keys: It is wide but flat: you can jump over it.
en: It is wide but flat: you can jump over it.
es: Es ancha pero plana: se puede saltar por encima.

keys: Short range: keeping your distance shuts it down.
en: Short range: keeping your distance shuts it down.
es: Corto alcance: guardar la distancia lo anula.

keys: It catches fire before setting off and goes straight: step aside. If it misses, it is wide open.
en: It catches fire before setting off and goes straight: step aside. If it misses, it is wide open.
es: Arde antes de salir y va en línea recta: apártate de lado. Si falla, queda muy expuesto.

keys: Almost no warning, but it goes straight: one step to the side is enough. If it misses, it stops dead.
en: Almost no warning, but it goes straight: one step to the side is enough. If it misses, it stops dead.
es: Sale casi sin aviso pero en línea recta: un paso de lado basta. Si falla, queda quieto.

keys: The cannons charge up first. It turns very slowly: step out of the line sideways.
en: The cannons charge up first. It turns very slowly: step out of the line sideways.
es: Los cañones se cargan antes. Gira muy despacio: sal de la línea de lado.

keys: It steers poorly: jump over it or dodge when it arrives.
en: It steers poorly: jump over it or dodge when it arrives.
es: Gira con poca precisión: salta por encima o esquiva cuando llegue.

keys: The cannons frost over before firing. Walk around the ice strip or jump it.
en: The cannons frost over before firing. Walk around the ice strip or jump it.
es: Los cañones escarchan antes del disparo. La franja de hielo se rodea o se salta.

keys: Long reach but in a line: it misses from the side. After the pull, dodge before the next hit.
en: Long reach but in a line: it misses from the side. After the pull, dodge before the next hit.
es: Alcanza lejos pero en línea: de lado no llega. Tras el tirón, esquiva antes del siguiente golpe.

keys: They spread out with distance: from far away, slip between them.
en: They spread out with distance: from far away, slip between them.
es: Se abren con la distancia: lejos, pasa entre ellas.

keys: The ground shows where it lands: leave the circle. Afterwards, do not step in the puddle.
en: The ground shows where it lands: leave the circle. Afterwards, do not step in the puddle.
es: El suelo marca dónde cae: sal del círculo. Después, no pises el charco.

keys: The charge is visible from afar: leave its line or punish it while it charges.
en: The charge is visible from afar: leave its line or punish it while it charges.
es: La carga se ve de lejos: sal de su línea o castígalo mientras carga.

keys: Uncharged, you cannot outrun it: dodge it when it is close. Charged, it goes straight: get out of its line.
en: Uncharged, you cannot outrun it: dodge it when it is close. Charged, it goes straight: get out of its line.
es: Sin cargar no se escapa corriendo: esquívala cuando esté cerca. Cargada va recta: apártate de su línea.

keys: The fist glows first: step aside. If it misses, Lucario is exposed.
en: The fist glows first: step aside. If it misses, Lucario is exposed.
es: El puño brilla antes: apártate de lado. Si falla, queda expuesto.

keys: Almost no warning, but it goes straight: move sideways. When it ends, turn around.
en: Almost no warning, but it goes straight: move sideways. When it ends, turn around.
es: Casi no avisa, pero va en línea recta: muévete de lado. Al acabar, date la vuelta.

keys: Do not attack right when it glows: wait for it to end and punish.
en: Do not attack right when it glows: wait for it to end and punish.
es: No ataques justo cuando brilla: espera a que acabe y castiga.

keys: It barely turns: a well-timed change of direction leaves it behind.
en: It barely turns: a well-timed change of direction leaves it behind.
es: Gira poco: un cambio de dirección a tiempo la deja atrás.

keys: Leave the mark before it bursts. With a status condition on you, it hurts twice as much.
en: Leave the mark before it bursts. With a status condition on you, it hurts twice as much.
es: Sal de la marca antes de que estalle. Con un estado encima, duele el doble.

keys: The real one glows less and has no shadow: look for it.
en: The real one glows less and has no shadow: look for it.
es: El de verdad brilla menos y no tiene sombra: búscalo por ahí.

keys: The cracks in the ground show where it is: move away or jump when it is about to come out. It is slow to react after emerging.
en: The cracks in the ground show where it is: move away or jump when it is about to come out. It is slow to react after emerging.
es: Las grietas del suelo dicen dónde está: apártate o salta cuando vaya a salir. Al salir tarda en reaccionar.

keys: The cracks mark the line: get off it or jump the spikes.
en: The cracks mark the line: get off it or jump the spikes.
es: Las grietas marcan la línea: sal de ella o salta las estacas.

keys: They come one at a time: move in a curve, not a straight line.
en: They come one at a time: move in a curve, not a straight line.
es: Llegan de uno en uno: muévete en curva, no en línea recta.

keys: It leaves smoke as it vanishes: turn to the side and dodge.
en: It leaves smoke as it vanishes: turn to the side and dodge.
es: Deja humo al irse: date la vuelta hacia el lado y esquiva.

keys: The copies have no shadow and do nothing: the one that moves is the real one.
en: The copies have no shadow and do nothing: the one that moves is the real one.
es: Las copias no tienen sombra ni hacen nada: el que se mueve es el de verdad.

keys: Almost no warning, but it is light: it does not interrupt moves with poise.
en: Almost no warning, but it is light: it does not interrupt moves with poise.
es: Casi no avisa pero es ligero: no corta lo que tenga aguante.

keys: The pincers open first: take a step back.
en: The pincers open first: take a step back.
es: Las pinzas se abren antes: retrocede un paso.

keys: It cannot defend itself while dancing: punish it. Afterwards, watch out for its two boosted hits.
en: It cannot defend itself while dancing: punish it. Afterwards, watch out for its two boosted hits.
es: Mientras baila no se defiende: castígalo. Después, cuidado con sus dos golpes.
Corto y en línea: apártate de lado.

keys: Agile and frail. Pressures, changes direction and never stands still.
en: Agile and frail. Pressures, changes direction and never stands still.
es: Ágil y frágil. Presiona, cambia de dirección y no se queda quieto.

keys: Huge and slow. Soaks up damage, takes up space and punishes every mistake.
en: Huge and slow. Soaks up damage, takes up space and punishes every mistake.
es: Enorme y lento. Aguanta, ocupa el espacio y castiga cada error.

keys: Mid-range pressure. Flies while its stamina lasts; it can never stay up forever.
en: Mid-range pressure. Flies while its stamina lasts; it can never stay up forever.
es: Presión a media distancia. Vuela mientras le dura el aguante; nunca se queda arriba siempre.

keys: Heavy. Controls lines with water and ice and punishes hard from range.
en: Heavy. Controls lines with water and ice and punishes hard from range.
es: Pesado. Controla líneas con agua y hielo y castiga fuerte desde lejos.

keys: Slow zoner. Long reach, fouls the ground and punishes anyone who gets careless.
en: Slow zoner. Long reach, fouls the ground and punishes anyone who gets careless.
es: Lento y de zona. Alcanza lejos, ensucia el suelo y castiga a quien se confía.

keys: Precise close-range fighter. Gets in fast, punishes and counters.
en: Precise close-range fighter. Gets in fast, punishes and counters.
es: Cuerpo a cuerpo y preciso. Entra rápido, castiga y contraataca.

keys: Slippery. Harasses from range, tricks and shows up where you least expect it.
en: Slippery. Harasses from range, tricks and shows up where you least expect it.
es: Escurridizo. Hostiga de lejos, engaña y aparece donde no se le espera.

keys: Aggressive and fast on the ground. Strikes from below and gives no breathing room.
en: Aggressive and fast on the ground. Strikes from below and gives no breathing room.
es: Agresivo y rápido por el suelo. Entra desde abajo y no deja respirar.

keys: Ninja. Never stops moving, throws from range and comes in from the sides.
en: Ninja. Never stops moving, throws from range and comes in from the sides.
es: Ninja. Se mueve sin parar, lanza desde lejos y entra por los lados.

keys: Close-range pressure with short advances. Punishes every mistake with its pincers.
en: Close-range pressure with short advances. Punishes every mistake with its pincers.
es: Presión de cerca con avances cortos. Castiga cada error con las pinzas.

keys: Whoever hits it up close is charged for 4 s. An Electric move against a charged target slows it and deals 25% more. Shown as sparks above it.
en: Whoever hits it up close is charged for 4 s. An Electric move against a charged target slows it and deals 25% more. Shown as sparks above it.
es: Quien le golpea de cerca queda cargado 4 s. Un movimiento eléctrico contra él le frena y hace un 25 % más. Se ve como chispas encima.

keys: Takes 30% less from Fire and Ice attacks. A message shows when it happens.
en: Takes 30% less from Fire and Ice attacks. A message shows when it happens.
es: Recibe un 30 % menos de los ataques de Fuego y Hielo. Lo avisa al recibirlos.

keys: Below a third of its HP, its Fire moves deal 25% more. Its tail flame burns brighter.
en: Below a third of its HP, its Fire moves deal 25% more. Its tail flame burns brighter.
es: Con menos de un tercio de vida, sus movimientos de Fuego hacen un 25 % más. Su cola arde más fuerte.

keys: Every Water move leaves it wet for 4 s, and while wet it slowly recovers HP. You can see the drops.
en: Every Water move leaves it wet for 4 s, and while wet it slowly recovers HP. You can see the drops.
es: Cada movimiento de Agua lo deja mojado 4 s, y mientras está mojado recupera vida poco a poco. Se ven las gotas.

keys: After a Grass move it runs 30% faster for 4 s. Leaves swirl around it while it lasts.
en: After a Grass move it runs 30% faster for 4 s. Leaves swirl around it while it lasts.
es: Tras un movimiento de Planta corre un 30 % más durante 4 s. Lo rodean hojas mientras dura.

keys: When one of its moves is interrupted or it is knocked down, it runs 20% faster for 3 s. A blue aura surrounds it.
en: When one of its moves is interrupted or it is knocked down, it runs 20% faster for 3 s. A blue aura surrounds it.
es: Cuando le cortan un movimiento o le derriban, corre un 20 % más durante 3 s. Lo envuelve un aura azul.

keys: It floats: Earthquake, puddles and ice cannot reach it. Its dodge is to vanish and reappear.
en: It floats: Earthquake, puddles and ice cannot reach it. Its dodge is to vanish and reappear.
es: Flota: Terremoto, los charcos y el hielo no le alcanzan. Su esquiva es desaparecer y reaparecer.

keys: Whoever hits it in melee gets hurt: 12% of the damage they deal. Sparks fly.
en: Whoever hits it in melee gets hurt: 12% of the damage they deal. Sparks fly.
es: Quien le golpea cuerpo a cuerpo se hace daño: un 12 % de lo que le quita. Saltan chispas.

keys: Takes the type of the last move it used, which changes its weaknesses. Shown by the icons on its frame.
en: Takes the type of the last move it used, which changes its weaknesses. Shown by the icons on its frame.
es: Toma el tipo del último movimiento que usa: cambian sus debilidades. Se ve en los iconos de su marco.

keys: Its light hits deal 25% more: Bullet Punch hits above its weight.
en: Its light hits deal 25% more: Bullet Punch hits above its weight.
es: Sus golpes ligeros hacen un 25 % más: Puño Bala pega por encima de lo normal.

keys: Against the AI. Pick your Pokémon, the rival and the difficulty.
en: Against the AI. Pick your Pokémon, the rival and the difficulty.
es: Contra la IA. Elige tu Pokémon, el rival y la dificultad.

keys: 1 vs 1 with a friend over the internet.
en: 1 vs 1 with a friend over the internet.
es: 1 contra 1 con un amigo por internet.

keys: Still or active rival, no rush. R resets, T stops or frees the rival.
en: Still or active rival, no rush. R resets, T stops or frees the rival.
es: Rival quieto o activo, sin prisas. R reinicia, T para o suelta al rival.

keys: Your friend joins with your IP. Port 7777 (UDP).
en: Your friend joins with your IP. Port 7777 (UDP).
es: Tu amigo se une con tu IP. Puerto 7777 (UDP).

keys: Type the IP of whoever hosted the game.
en: Type the IP of whoever hosted the game.
es: Escribe la IP de quien ha creado la partida.

en: Models, animations, particles, sounds and battle UI: the Cobblemon team (CC BY-NC 3.0, adapted)
